name: Lieutenant's Insignia
label: Item
description: Within Durotar, Lieutenant's Insignia carries the Burning Blade's mark. Horde adventurers recover it from cultists near Orgrimmar.
intro: Within Durotar, Lieutenant's Insignia carries the Burning Blade's mark. Horde adventurers recover it from cultists near Orgrimmar.

p: Cultists at Skull Rock on Durotar's eastern shore carry Lieutenant's Insignia. The emblem marks its bearer as an officer of the Burning Blade. Warchief Thrall will not tolerate traitors in his new nation, but a purge could scatter the cult before its masters are exposed. He gives the badge to a trusted champion to test suspected infiltrators beneath Orgrimmar.
